measurementProvenance.scope: Recorded source byte/hash and committed workload identities only; no timings or equivalence workloads re-executed, no physical-hardware claim.
measurementProvenance.pinQualification: Lane, surface and simulation tools capture the current HEAD and exact input hashes without requiring an expected-current argument. All recorded commits and bytes were verified independently here; their clean source/stability records remain separate from an explicit preselected revision pin.

leaseEvidenceLimit: Git parent/tree/ref observations demonstrate preserved ancestry and exact objects. These durable receipts do not contain an independently captured API mutation request or transport audit log; no claim is made that Git objects alone prove historical force/lease flags.
